cards.label: Expectation Failure
cards.definition: Use small surprises or mistakes to help people update their understanding.
cards.why_it_matters: When ideas clash with expectations, people pay more attention and remember better.
cards.caution: Too much confusion can cause frustration — keep it safe and supported.

cards.minimum_bar: One moment that gently challenges assumptions.
cards.gold_standard: Several low-risk challenges with guided reflection.

cards.label: Productive Friction

phases.label: Model

phases.purpose: Learner performs with partial guidance or scaffolds.
